mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_goal_task (task_id, user_id, conversation_id, status, input_json, event_seq, budget_profile_key, budget_limit_microunits) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, 'QUEUED', #{inputJson}, 1, 'STANDARD', #{budgetLimitMicrounits})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, user_id, conversation_id, status, version, plan_version, answer_revision, cancel_requested_at, blocked_reason, create_time, last_update_time FROM sq_goal_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT conversation_id FROM sq_goal_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
SELECT conversation_id FROM sq_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, task_id, user_id, conversation_id, status, version, plan_version, answer_revision, cancel_requested_at, blocked_reason, create_time, last_update_time FROM sq_goal_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
SELECT input_json FROM sq_goal_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_goal_task SET status = 'CANCELLING', version = version + 1, cancel_requested_at = #{cancelledAt} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLING', 'SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')
UPDATE sq_goal_task SET status = 'QUEUED', blocked_reason = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE sq_goal_task SET status = 'RECOVERY_BLOCKED', blocked_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, user_id, conversation_id, status, version, plan_version, answer_revision, cancel_requested_at, blocked_reason, create_time, last_update_time FROM sq_goal_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND (#{cursorId} IS NULL OR id < #{cursorId}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
